name: USTX
oneLiner: USTX is a Brale-issued dollar stablecoin for settling tokenized stocks, ETFs and other assets on tx, live in the tx wallet since October 2026.
collateral: Pre-launch: tx promises full 1:1 backing for USTX issued by Brale. Brale's program-level policy specifies segregated reserves held separately from corporate assets, daily reconciliation and monthly independent CPA attestations, with reserves in US Treasury bills of at most 90 days, government money market funds and bank deposits. These issuer commitments do not establish USTX-specific allocations, custodians or a retrieved independent reserve report.
pegMechanism: Planned native USD settlement asset on tx, issued by Brale. Exact USTX mint and redemption eligibility, fees, minimums, timing and capacity are unpublished. Brale general terms restrict purchases and redemptions to qualifying accounts and permit suspension.
launchPhaseDetail: tx launched USTX on October 20 2026, issued by Brale and backed 1:1 by US dollar reserves; users mint it on the tx chain by depositing USDC from Ethereum, Solana, Base or Polygon. The issuer has published no asset details, but the chain shows USTX, created on October 8 2026, as denom uustx-core1rfxrg75fzuq5hgnnymjgsxj70d9w9cs8xuza7x with 6 decimals, clawback enabled and an issuer-owned extension contract that can pause transfers and blacklist addresses. Supply was 4,833 USTX across 55 holders on November 1 2026. USTX is live, but Pharos tracks it pre-launch because no price listing or redemption terms have been published and the tx chain is not a Pharos-supported chain, so its supply cannot enter runtime data.

listingStatusReview.reason: Missing lanes: price and supply. USTX exists on the tx chain as denom uustx-core1rfxrg75fzuq5hgnnymjgsxj70d9w9cs8xuza7x with 6 decimals, but Pharos does not support that chain and neither CoinGecko nor DefiLlama lists it.

milestones.title: tx announces native USTX issued by Brale
milestones.description: The issuer partnership promises full 1:1 backing and an October launch for settlement of tokenized stocks, ETFs and other real-world assets.

milestones.title: Brale creates the USTX token on the tx chain
milestones.description: Brale's issuer account created USTX on the tx chain (chain ID coreum-mainnet-1) as denom uustx-core1rfxrg75fzuq5hgnnymjgsxj70d9w9cs8xuza7x, with 6 decimals and zero initial supply. The token enables minting, IBC transfers, clawback and an issuer-owned extension contract that can pause transfers and blacklist addresses.

milestones.title: tx launches Brale-issued USTX
milestones.description: Brale announced that tx launched USTX on October 20 2026 as a native stablecoin for its tokenized asset marketplace, issued by Brale and backed 1:1 by US dollar reserves. Users mint USTX on the tx chain by depositing USDC from Ethereum, Solana, Base or Polygon. No contract address, decimals or supply figure was published.

featuredContent.description: Brale's announcement that tx launched USTX on October 20 2026, minted on the tx chain against USDC deposits.
